column3: Close to the Hebrew; “The firmament of his strength” is rendered “His mighty expanse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The greatness of his greatness” is rendered “His excellent greatness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A blast of a ram’s horn” is rendered “trumpet sound.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Tambourine” is rendered “timbrel,” and “flute” as “pipe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Cymbals of sound … cymbals of shouting” is rendered “loud cymbals … resounding cymbals.”
